steps.title: Create CSV transfer file
steps.instruction: Prepare a .csv file that includes a header line "Source Well,Volume,Destination Well" and list each transfer on a new row, starting with data in cells A2 (Source Well), B2 (Volume), and C2 (Destination Well).

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Select the pipette model and specify its mount (left or right). Choose the source labware type and the destination labware type from the available options, and decide the tip‑use strategy (reuse the same tip or use a new tip for each transfer).

substeps.instruction: Select Source Labware Type (e.g., Starlab Deepwell Plate, Eppendorf 2 mL Tube in Tube Rack, Eppendorf 1.5 mL Tube in Tube Rack, NEST 96‑Well 200 µL Flat, NEST 96‑Well 100 µL PCR, BioRad 96‑Well 200 µL PCR, Corning 96‑Well 360 µL Flat, Corning 384‑Well 112 µL Flat, USA Scientific 96‑Deepwell 2.4 mL).
Select Destination Labware Type (same options as source).
Choose Tip Use Strategy (same tip for all transfers or new tip for each transfer).

steps.title: Load selected labware onto deck
steps.instruction: Place the chosen source and destination labware onto the robot deck according to the selected types, ensuring the labware matches the capacities listed (e.g., 200 µL, 100 µL, 360 µL, 112 µL, 2.4 mL).

substeps.instruction: Load source labware (e.g., Starlab Deepwell Plate, etc.).
Load destination labware (same options as source).

steps.title: Aspirate specified volume
steps.instruction: For each row of the CSV, command the pipette to aspirate the volume indicated in the "Volume" column from the well indicated in the "Source Well" column.

steps.title: Dispense into destination well
steps.instruction: Immediately after aspiration, dispense the aspirated volume into the well indicated in the "Destination Well" column of the CSV.

steps.title: Repeat for all CSV rows
steps.instruction: Iterate steps 4 and 5 sequentially for every transfer listed in the CSV file until the file is exhausted.
